meta.name: vanish-ai Design System (App-Exact)
meta.purpose: A comprehensive, AI-readable guide to build new features in this repo with consistent styling. This document reflects the ACTUAL Tailwind classes, tokens, and component patterns in the codebase (not a hypothetical system).
sourceOfTruthFiles: frontend/src/index.css (global CSS + shadcn variables + base font)

nonNegotiables: Use Tailwind utility classes (no new CSS frameworks).
Default UI (Vanish) remains dark, high-contrast, tool-first.
Dashboard UI (Aurora) is glassmorphism: translucent surfaces + blur + thin borders + restrained glow.
Prefer spacing over dividers. Dividers only for tables/lists.
Every interactive element must have a visible hover + disabled + focus state.
informationHierarchy: 1) Scale/size establishes hierarchy (hero headline, card titles).
2) Contrast/opacity establishes secondary levels (muted copy, helper text).
3) Accent color is used sparingly for the primary action and key states.

containers: All sections: container mx-auto max-w-7xl / max-w-6xl / max-w-4xl
App/editor: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 (grid with sidebar 220px)
sectionRhythm: All sections: py-12 px-4 (clinical spacing, no bloat)
Editor surfaces: p-4 to p-6 with gap-6
Dashboard: gap-6, cards p-4 to p-6, tables inside rounded containers

vanish.borders: graphite borders and electric-blue borders at low opacity (border-electric-blue/20)

primaryRadii: rounded-2xl (glass cards, table shells, sidebar containers)
aurora.borders: thin white borders at low opacity (border-white/10 to border-white/16)

techAndStylingStack.utilityHelper: cn() via clsx + tailwind-merge in frontend/src/lib/utils.ts

auroraFont.usage: Applied at page root in Dashboard: className includes font-helvetica

commonTypePatterns.cardTitle: text-xl (or text-2xl in CardTitle) font-semibold text-white

aurora: Primary text: text-white/92 (headlines, brand names, stat values)

Secondary text: text-white/86 (card titles, table emphasis), text-white/72 (nav items, table cells), text-white/70 (status text, badges), text-white/62 (descriptions), text-white/56 (subtitles, deltas), text-white/52 (labels, meta text)
Borders: border-white/16 (strong emphasis), border-white/14 (search input), border-white/12 (cards, pills), border-white/10 (subtle dividers, table shells)
Glass fill: bg-white/7 (cards, logo icon), bg-white/6 (search, account card, pills, table header), bg-white/12 (active nav items), bg-white/8 (hover states), bg-white/5 (table header background)
Ring: ring-white/8 (card inner ring), ring-white/16 (active nav items)
Glow: shadow-[0_0_XXpx_rgba(...)] sparingly, specific recipes documented in effects.aurora.glowRecipe

spacingPhilosophy.verticalRhythm: py-12 for sections, py-8 for editor, gap-6 everywhere
spacingPhilosophy.antiPattern: Never use py-20 or larger spacing - contradicts Dashboard's tight, professional aesthetic

whenAddingNewComponents: Pick the theme first: Vanish (void/graphite/electric-blue) or Aurora (ink/white glass/aurora accents). Do not blend them unless explicitly requested.
Use existing primitives (`Button`, `Card`, `Slider`) unless there is a clear reason not to.
Match existing spacing patterns: py-12 sections, p-4..p-6 panels, gap-6 grids. NEVER use py-20 or larger.
Define all interaction states (hover, focus-visible, disabled) using opacity and border changes; keep motion subtle.

copyTone.vanish: Direct, tool-like, action-forward. Avoid cute language in errors.
copyTone.aurora: Concise, premium, confidence. Minimal words, high signal.

antiPatterns: Do not introduce random new grays; use graphite/muted-gray or white opacities as established.
Do not add heavy drop shadows to Vanish surfaces; rely on borders and subtle elevation.
Do not introduce new component libraries without instruction.
NEVER use py-20 or excessive spacing - this contradicts the clinical Dashboard aesthetic.
Do not assume 'marketing' sections need different spacing - everything is tight and efficient.
